subject: Synchronize changing motion-obstacle sectors with perimeter lines
description: The old schema-12 representative `parity-random-save-replays-60s-15x/traces/Savegame_nicouzouf/Profile_001/Savegame_010/replay-012-session-0001.jsonl.zst` formerly diverged after frame 1142 only on Projectile106's landing topology: Original assigned layer/sector 0 while Rust retained no layer/sector. The bit-exact bare-ground terminal footprint `(626.4479370117188,568.0276489257813)` lies inside motion area 0. Rust found that area, then incorrectly cleared it because overlapping non-area motion sector 18 still appeared active even though all eleven of its associated perimeter lines were inactive. Original `RHPathFinder::SetStateArea` deactivates or activates each changing `RHSector` and immediately mirrors the same state to its perimeter lines through `RHFastFindGrid::SetLineForMotionSectorActive` (`original-code/RHpathfinder.cpp:2827-2878`); `RHFastFindGrid::GetSectors` admits only active sectors (`original-code/RHfastfindgrid.cpp:1352-1367`). Commit `5361c9f001a4b5f82c5a62ff6a593150971d7ab2` binds every pathfinder motion obstacle to its exact fast-grid sector slot and synchronizes sector plus line activation during fresh initialization, runtime patch changes, legacy patch reconstruction, and saved pathfinder-state adoption. The optional/defaulted serialized binding keeps historical serde shapes readable, while every required runtime use rejects a missing or out-of-range binding instead of inventing topology. All 18 `pathfinder::tests` passed, including registered fresh-initialization state, applied inactive-to-active and active-to-inactive transitions, compatibility decoding, and missing-binding rejection; both `graph_state_preflight_` tests and the focused legacy-grid adoption test also passed. A freshly rebuilt optimized runner matches the representative and nearby control `parity-random-save-replays-60s-15x/traces/Savegame_nicouzouf/Profile_001/Savegame_010/replay-011-session-0001.jsonl.zst` through exact EOF: each covers 1,500 recorded frames from 11 through 1510, with 2,594 and 2,190 RNG draws respectively. This dry inactive-sector fix is independent of Task484's water-owned projectile-dive lifecycle.
